summary.incident_subtype: Obstruction of agricultural path by electric meter box
dispatcher_actions: Advised the caller to visit the nearest police station and submit a written application since there is no active physical dispute at the moment.
key_facts: The path to the fields was legally cleared to 6 feet in 2014 by a court order.
Another farmer has placed an electric pump meter box on the path, reducing the width to about 4.5 feet.
Tractors and trolleys are unable to pass through, causing difficulties in reaching the fields.
The caller fears a major dispute will occur once the sowing season begins.
The village Sarpanch and the electricity department were contacted previously, but the opposing party did not cooperate.
There is no active physical fight or emergency at the location currently; the caller called to prevent future escalation.
summary.final_summary: The caller, Arjun Ganesh from Baghora, reported that an agricultural path, which was cleared to 6 feet by a court order in 2014, is currently obstructed by an electric meter box installed by another farmer. This has reduced the path to 4.5 feet, preventing tractors from passing. While there is no active clash at the moment, the caller anticipates a dispute during the upcoming sowing season. The call taker advised the caller to file a formal complaint at the nearest police station.
